% resume.tex
% ATS-friendly: single column, standard section headings, no tables/graphics
% in the body (the portfolio document is where visuals live, not this).
% Content is auto-generated from data/resume.yaml into
% sections/resume_content.tex by scripts/build.py — edit the YAML, not
% this file, to change what's in the resume.
\documentclass[10.5pt]{article}

\usepackage[margin=0.75in]{geometry}
\usepackage{titlesec}
\usepackage{enumitem}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\usepackage{../shared/theme}      % colors/fonts, generated from data/theme.yaml
\input{../shared/title.tex}       % \myName, \myEmail, etc. — generated from data/title.yaml

\hypersetup{colorlinks=true, urlcolor=blueprint500, linkcolor=blueprint500}
\pagestyle{empty}
\setlist[itemize]{leftmargin=1.1em, itemsep=1pt, topsep=2pt}

\titleformat{\section}{\displayfont\bfseries\textSectionHeading\color{graphite900}}{}{0em}{}[{\color{blueprint500}\titlerule[0.8pt]}]
\titlespacing{\section}{0pt}{10pt}{6pt}

\begin{document}

% ---- header ----
\begin{center}
  {\displayfont\bfseries\LARGE \myName}\\[2pt]
  {\color{steel700} \myTagline}\\[4pt]
  \small \myLocation\ \textbar\ \myEmail\ \textbar\ \myPhone\ \textbar\
  \href{\myGithub}{GitHub} \textbar\ \href{\myLinkedin}{LinkedIn}
\end{center}

% ---- body — auto-generated from data/resume.yaml, do not hand-edit sections/resume_content.tex ----
\input{sections/resume_content.tex}

\end{document}
